title: Please Don’t Sit on the Flowers
summary: Long-lost Georgia O’Keeffe landscape goes to auction, Brancusi gets lost at MoMA, interview with Doris Salcedo, and is showing at documenta worth it?

title: The Jewish Sisters in Renoir’s “Pink and Blue”
summary: Author Catherine Ostler follows the lives of the two cherubic girls, whose rarefied lives in an elite, artistic French family would be toppled by the horrors of the Holocaust.

title: Pablo Helguera to Helm the New School’s Vera List Center
summary: Upon his appointment, the artist reflected on the urgency he feels to “make sense of rapidly unfolding events, question prevailing narratives, and imagine alternative futures.”

title: Meg Onli and Zack Winokur to Curate 2028 Whitney Biennial
summary: Having co-curated the 2024 Biennial, Onli returns to the next edition with Winokur, who founded the American Modern Opera Company.

title: DC Protesters Slam Trump's Fascist Triumphal Arch
summary: A group of 50 used puppets and a fake arch to deliver the point that Americans are against the "Arc de Trump."

title: Jordan Poorman Cocker’s Vision of Global Indigeneity
summary: The curator, who just organized a major rehang of Indigenous art at Crystal Bridges, reflects on the ways institutions can create space for Native artists to flourish.

title: A View From the Easel: Natali Bravo-Barbee
summary: “As a mother, there are so many spaces in my life that are organized around other people’s needs. The studio is a space where I get to return to myself.”

title: Intermedia + Digital Arts MFA Program at UMBC Now Accepting Applications
summary: Funding for tuition, healthcare, and stipends is available. Apply to the University of Maryland, Baltimore County program by Feb 1 to be considered for financial support.

title: Met Gala’s New Theme Is So Basic
summary: Brancusi at MoMA, trouble at Pace, a rediscovered Georgia O'Keeffe painting, and The Met presents the biggest rescission indicator yet.

title: It’s Time to Talk About Classism in the Art World
summary: In his memoiristic new book, photographer Mark Alice Durant weaves his personal experiences into a larger rebuke of the economic inequality that governs the art world.

title: Met Gala's New Theme Is the Biggest Recession Indicator Yet
summary: Brace yourself for A-listers strutting down the red carpet in everyday garb like jeans, T-shirts, and "humble, even 'disposable' materials."

title: MFA Boston to Allow Visitors to Watch Live Conservation of Dutch Painting
summary: Nicolaes Eliasz Pickenoy’s 17th-century group portrait of an Amsterdam wine guild will be the star of a pop-up restoration studio that museumgoers can peer into.

title: The Glimchers Can’t Keep Up the Pace
summary: The mega gallery is struggling, Ebony L. Haynes joins Marian Goodman Gallery, longtime Manifesta director steps down, and more in Art Movements.

title: At MoMA, Brancusi Is Lost in Space
summary: The artist’s work is glorious and resonant, but the Museum of Modern Art has a space problem, or an elegance problem, or a crowd mitigation problem.

title: Shape Your Artistic Future at UC Davis: The Maria Manetti Shrem Art Studio MFA Program
summary: Generously funded, renowned faculty and visiting artists, spacious studios, and an exhibition at the Manetti Shrem Museum of Art.
